rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for improvement or development to a better state.

example.english: You’ve made a lot of progress learning Cantonese lately.
example.traditional: 你最近學廣東話進步咗好多。
example.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zeon3 bou6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for the amount or stage of progress made on a task, project, or journey.

example.english: How far along is this project in terms of progress?
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6 heoi3 dou3 bin1

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on an advance or development toward an objective rather than on measurable progress.

example.english: Has there been any progress with the matter?
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 jau5 mou5 zeon3 zin2
